data.narrative:
Maritime Fusion is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Justin Cohen and Jason Kaufmann that has raised $4.5M to date. The addressable sector contains nine comparable companies: one public entity (Lanzatech, ticker LNZA) and eight private firms including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Of the two valuation methods assessed, only stage-progression proved applicable. The peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient narrow comparables—while eight same-sector peers exist in Climate & Energy, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier, and falling back to broad sector medians would introduce excessive noise. The stage-progression method applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $4.5M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $11.25M. This multiplier reflects typical Seed-to-Series A step-up dynamics in frontier technology investing.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $9.6M to $12.9M, with a median estimate of $11M. This range reflects the single-method constraint and the early-stage nature of the company, where fundamental metrics remain limited. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or technical milestone data, narrow peer comparability within Maritime Fusion's specific subsector, and stage-progression volatility in climate tech, where funding multiples vary materially by technology maturity and capital intensity.
